For Loop

The one idea to landA for loop does not count. It walks a sequence and stops when the sequence runs out, so the only question worth asking is what is in this sequence. range(start, end) just builds one, and it stops before the end value. That is why the row you wanted is missing.

Recap: the while loop in three parts

Recap
Recap: the while loop in three parts

Recap

The while loop, in three parts

Three parts on the left, three jobs on the right. Call out which two go together, then we join them.

1counter = 0
2while counter < 3:
3counter = counter + 1
1Sets the starting value. Runs once, before the loop.
3Moves the counter on, so the question can turn false.
2The question asked before every pass.

Initialization. Miss it and the name does not exist yet, so line 2 cannot even be asked.

The condition. For this program it is asked 4 times, not 3: once before each pass, and once more at the end when the answer is finally no.

Updation. Take this line out and the answer stays yes for ever, and the program never stops.

One tap, and it keeps going

The listA Spotify playlist you made. Five songs.

One tapYou tap play once. Song one starts.

It moves on its ownSong one ends. Song two starts. You did not touch the phone.

Right to the end, then it stopsThe last song ends and it stops. Nothing says five. So what told it to stop?

Add one songNow there are six. It plays six. You never typed a number.

Worksheet task 1 Fill the table by hand first. Nothing here moves until pens are down.
Line 1 word now holds the two characters H and i.
Line 2 n starts at 0.
Line 3, first pass The loop takes the first item out of the sequence. ch is H.
Line 4 n goes from 0 to 1.
Line 5 It prints whatever ch is holding right now.
Line 3, second pass Back to the loop. It takes the next item. ch is i.
Line 4 n goes from 1 to 2.
Line 5 It prints i.
Line 3, third try The loop asks for the next item. There is none left, so the loop ends.
Line 6 It prints n, which is 2. Two characters, two passes.

Riya
I want to save money. But I will save only on odd days.
Day 1 is odd. I put in ₹1.
Day 2 is even. Nothing for me today!
Day 3 is odd. I put in ₹3.
Day 5 gives ₹5. Day 7 gives ₹7. Now I have ₹16!
What about 30 days? Or a whole year? I can't add all that by hand!

Lines 1 and 2 n is 7. total starts at 0.
Day 1 1 is odd. total goes from 0 to 1.
Day 2 2 is even. The if is False, so total stays 1.
Day 3 3 is odd. total goes from 1 to 4.
Day 4 4 is even. The if is False, so total stays 4.
Day 5 5 is odd. total goes from 4 to 9.
Day 6 6 is even. The if is False, so total stays 9.
Day 7 7 is odd. total goes from 9 to 16.
No days left range stops before 8. The loop ends.
Line 6 It prints 16. That is Riya's money after 7 days.

Exit question
Why it prints nothing
seats.py
1seats = int(input())2booked = int(input())3left = seats - booked4for i in range(1, left):5    print("Seat", i)
seats4
booked3
left1
range(1, 1)no numbers
nothing printed
Option B. seats is 4 and booked is 3.
Line 3. left is 4 minus 3, which is 1.
Line 4. range(1, 1) starts at 1 and stops before 1. It has no numbers in it.
Nothing is printed. The loop body never runs, so the screen stays empty.
